decisions.reason: Disabling the selectable card option while it is unimplemented does not alter the deferred Transak integration's provider, methods, fulfillment, or lifecycle.
The candidate already requires ETH payment to be enabled; the inability to select ETH is an execution issue and the source decision does not change that requirement state.
USDC remains selectable, and the source decision neither changes the USDC mint behavior nor any of its current attributes.
Temporarily disabling the unimplemented card selector does not change mint price, revenue shares, fee handling, or prize-pool allocation.
The payment-method selection decision does not affect optional tipping behavior or its available amounts.
The source disables an unavailable card-selection control but does not revise the intended embedded-wallet or reward-access behavior for future fiat buyers.
Primary-mint payment-option availability does not alter secondary-sale royalty rules or enforcement.
The no-referral reward allocation remains applicable regardless of which enabled payment method is selected.
The source requests that an unimplemented card option be non-selectable but does not explicitly revise the persistent FAQ description of the planned Transak capability.
The same message reports a separate View Book failure, but the payment-selection decision does not change the rule for displaying successfully owned NFTs.
Payment-option availability does not change the condition that success feedback appears only after an actual mint.
The payment-selector change does not alter Small Block prize amounts, draw conditions, or funding rules.
